target.title: fix(codex): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in exec resume
target.body:
## Summary

**Problem**: Stream errors on Codex child stdout/stderr pipes (triggered when the pipe is destroyed before fully consumed) were propagated through reject but the orphaned child process continued running after the promise settled, wasting resources and leaving process handles outside the caller's lifecycle.

**Solution**: Add a `terminateChild()` helper (SIGTERM → 2s-escalted SIGKILL) and a `settled` guard inside the exit-code promise to ensure exactly one settlement path runs. Stream errors terminate the child before rejecting; the existing timeout and child-exit paths also respect the guard.

**What changed**: `runCodexExecResume` now kills the child process and awaits its exit before rejecting on stream errors. 4 new tests assert `childRef.killed === true` in every error scenario. **What did not change**: Normal execution path (no stream error) is identical; timeout handling is unchanged; caller-facing API is unchanged.

Fixes #106227

---

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Stream errors on Codex child stdout/stderr pipes now terminate the orphaned child before rejecting, instead of leaving the child running outside the caller's lifecycle.

**Real environment tested**: Linux 4.19.112-2.el8.x86_64, Node.js v24.1.0, OpenClaw current main with patch applied.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**: `pnpm vitest run extensions/codex/src/node-cli-sessions.test.ts --reporter=verbose`

```bash
cd /media/vdc/0668001277/Projects2/github-LeonidasLux/openclaw
pnpm vitest run extensions/codex/src/node-cli-sessions.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**After-fix evidence**: All 10 tests pass; 4 stream-error tests assert `childRef.killed === true` after rejection.

Current HEAD: fc697cc6ed

```
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on stdout stream error and terminates child 28ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on stderr stream error and terminates child 24ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on simultaneous stdout and stderr errors and terminates child 20ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > terminates child that would otherwise keep running after stream error 21ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

**Observed result after the fix**: All 10 tests pass. Each stream-error test captures a `childRef` and asserts `childRef.killed === true` after rejection, confirming the child process is terminated before the promise settles. The "indefinite" test spawns a child that has no auto-exit timeout (`process.stdin.resume()` without `setTimeout`) — the handler still kills it before rejecting, proving termination works without relying on child self-exit.

**What was not tested**: End-to-end Codex CLI `exec resume` with a real codex session hitting a true pipe destruction scenario. The tests exercise the production handler via an injected `spawnFn` that returns a real spawned Node child with synchronously destroyed pipes — this proves the handler's error paths correctly terminate children, but not that real Codex exec-resume pipe destruction actually occurs in production (that depends on the child OS process implementation and pipe buffer state).

## Tests and validation

### Unit tests

```

 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex cli node sessions > ignores Date-invalid ... 3ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex cli node sessions > lists sessions from Codex ... 5ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex cli node sessions > reports malformed ... 4ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex cli node sessions > keeps Codex history ... 5ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex cli node sessions > keeps Codex session-file ... 5ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on stdout ... 28ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on stderr ... 24ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > rejects on simultaneous ... 20ms
 ✓ |extension-codex| ... codex exec resume stream error handling > terminates child ... 21ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

## Risk checklist

- [x] This change is backwards compatible
- [x] This change has been tested with existing configurations
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] Breaking changes (if any) are documented in Summary
- **Merge-risk explanation**: Low. Stream errors are rare (pipe destruction before consumption). The patch adds a child-termination path that mirrors existing timeout-based cleanup. Behavioral change is confined to the error path and covered by 4 new tests. The `settled` guard prevents double-settlement in all race scenarios.
